premises: The (TaNb)0.67(HfZrTi)0.33 HEA retains its bcc structure up to at least 96 GPa.
Superconductivity with zero resistance persists in this HEA up to ~190 GPa.
The bcc structure's resilience under pressure is responsible for maintaining robust electron–phonon coupling.
